values.note: 47 full-hookup and 39 electric sites (all 20/30/50 A), mostly pull-throughs of 65-105 ft; the shortest is a 50-ft back-in. Besides these, two host sites (H01, H49) and a youth group area outside the campground.

booking.source: https://iowastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/lake-ahquabi-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=IA&parkId=610149 ('This campground is 100 percent reservable and accepts reservations March 1 - November 30 until 10:00 pm CST the day of arrival.') + DNR park page ('100% of the campsites are reservable and a reservation is required'), read 2026-11-03

note: Iowa DNR park on 115-acre Lake Ahquabi south of Indianola, with a sandy beach, a CCC stone lodge and a trail around the lake; the campground sits north-east of the lake. No daily park-entry fee in Iowa. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 20/30/50A, 47 FHU + 39 electric (86 public sites, 50-155 ft, mostly pull-through), showers, dump, 100% reservable to 10 pm day of arrival, season Mar 1-Nov 30. Sites 96 -> 86, max 85 -> 155. Not waterfront confirmed. Pin ~875 m off: corrected.
flags: PIN (~875 m off): stored 41.28917,-93.58750 is south-east of the campground, beyond the lake. The 89 RA site points centre on 41.29589,-93.59291. Proposed location 41.29589,-93.59291.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed. Every RA site is tagged 'Near Water - no' and 'Proximity to Water' is blank; on NAIP the nearest sites (87, 88, 93 at the south-west corner) are ~60-70 m from the lake behind the loop road, wetland and trees, and RA photos of 47, 67, 87, 88, 89 and 93 show lawn and woods, no water.
SITES: stored 96 was RA's total listing count (including the lodge, shelter, youth area and two host sites); 86 public campsites. Stored max 85 ft ignored the longer pull-throughs (up to 155).
